    A data frame containing words, their lemmas and stem of the lemmas

    word_lemma_stem.Rd

    The lemmas come from the Lexique data base. The stems are obtained by stemming these lemmas using the SnowballC package.

    Usage

    word_lemma_stem

    Format

    A data frame with 3 columns and 142,694 rows.

    Details

    This data frame can be used to get a vector of words that are closely related to a keyword of interest.
